# 1. Load in libraries
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra) # raster handling
library(tmap) # map making
library(stars)
```


# 2. Load in and prepare data
```{r}
#| message: false
#| results: hide

# Load night lights data (rasters)
# maybe use read_stars()
feb_7_h5 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif")
feb_7_h6 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif")
feb_16_h5 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif")
feb_16_h6 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif")

# Load roads data
# Query for just highways
roads_query <- "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'"
# Reading in highways data
highways <- st_read("data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg", query=roads_query) # vector

# Load houses data
# Query for certain buildings
houses_query <- "SELECT *
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
OR type in ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')"
# Reading in houses data
houses <- st_read("data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg", query=houses_query) # vector
```

## Checking if CRSs match
```{r}
st_crs(highway) == st_crs(houses) # true
st_crs(feb_16_h6) == st_crs(houses)
st_crs(feb_16_h6) == st_crs(roads)
st_crs(feb_7_h6) == st_crs(houses)
st_crs(feb_7_h6) == st_crs(roads)
st_crs(feb_7_h6) == st_crs(feb_16_h6)
```


## Data Merging

Houston lies on the border of two tiles. Need to combine these two tiles together to get one raster for each date (2021-02-07 and 2021-02-16).
```{r}
houston_feb_7 <- st_mosaic(feb_7_h5, feb_7_h6)
houston_feb_16 <- st_mosaic(feb_16_h5, feb_16_h6)
```


## Create blackout mask
```{r}
# Find the change in night lights intensity caused by the storm
night_light_diff <- rast(houston_feb_7) - rast(houston_feb_16)

# Reclassify the difference raster, assuming that any location that experienced a drop of more than 200 nW cm^-2 sr^-1 experienced a blackout

# Create reclassification matrix
rcl <- matrix(c(
          -Inf, 200, 0, # 0 means no blackout
          200, Inf, 1 # 1 means blackout
          ),
          ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Use reclassification to reclassify elevation
reclass_lights <- classify(night_light_diff, rcl = rcl)
summary(reclass_lights)

# Assign NA to locations without blackouts
blackout_mask <- ifel(reclass_lights == 0, NA, 1)

# Convert raster to polygons
blackout_mask_vect <- as.polygons(blackout_mask, na.rm = TRUE)

# Convert polygons to sf
blackout_mask_vect <- st_as_sf(blackout_mask_vect)

# Crop to Houston area
# Crop to Houston area
houston_bbox <- st_bbox(c(
  xmin = -96.5,
  ymin = 29,
  xmax = -94.5,
  ymax = 30.5
), crs = st_crs(blackout_mask_vect))

houston_blackout <- st_make_valid(
  st_crop(blackout_mask_vect, houston_bbox)
)

# re-projecting blackout to EPSG:3083
houston_reproject <- st_transform(houston_blackout, crs = "EPSG:3083")

```


## Exclude highways from the cropped blackout mask
```{r}
# Transforming CRS to match
highways <- st_transform(highways, crs = "EPSG:3083")

# Creating a 200m buffer
highways_buffer <- st_buffer(highways, dist = 200)

# Combining buffers
highway_buffer_union <- st_union(highways_buffer)

# Excluding highways
blackout_no_highways <- st_difference(houston_reproject, highway_buffer_union)
```
